context: Boss and manager rehearse a board statement about an acquisition
purpose: Teach: 買収/債権/手数料/中止/ドメイン/マネジメント/廃棄/本件

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ケンジ君、明日の取締役会で本件についてどう説明するか、もう一度確認しておきたい。
lines.en: Kenji, I want to go over how we'll explain this matter at tomorrow's board meeting one more time.
lines.style: Authoritative boss in his sixties, deep gravelly voice, measured pace, formal business register

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、社長。今回の買収について、まずは戦略的な意義からご説明する流れで考えております。
lines.en: Yes, sir. Regarding this acquisition, I was thinking of starting with the strategic significance.
lines.style: Diligent middle manager, polite keigo, slightly nervous but professional, clear enunciation

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: うむ。ただし、相手企業が抱えている債権の処理について、必ず触れておいてくれ。
lines.en: Hmm. However, make sure to address the handling of the debts the target company is carrying.
lines.style: Boss speaking firmly, lowering voice for emphasis, businesslike concern, no-nonsense tone

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 承知いたしました。アドバイザリーの手数料も含めた総コストの内訳も資料に入れてございます。
lines.en: Understood. I've also included a cost breakdown in the materials, including advisory fees.
lines.style: Polite manager confirming details, slight upward inflection of reassurance, careful and respectful

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: それから、競合のM社が交渉を中止したという噂が出ているが、そこは触れない方が無難だな。
lines.en: Also, there are rumors that competitor M Corp pulled out of negotiations, but it's safer not to mention that.
lines.style: Boss thinking aloud strategically, slightly hushed conspiratorial tone, careful word choice

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: おっしゃる通りです。それと旧システムの廃棄スケジュールについても、簡潔に触れる予定です。
lines.en: Exactly as you say. I also plan to briefly touch on the disposal schedule for the legacy systems.
lines.style: Manager agreeing respectfully, then pivoting smoothly to next agenda item, confident professional tone

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: それでいい。あと、向こうのドメインとブランド資産は、グループのマネジメント体制に統合する方針で頼む。
lines.en: That's fine. Also, please proceed with integrating their domain and brand assets into the group's management structure.
lines.style: Boss issuing clear directives, firm and decisive, slight pause before the directive verb

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: かしこまりました。では明朝、最終版の原稿を社長室にお持ちいたします。
lines.en: Certainly. Then I'll bring the final draft of the script to your office tomorrow morning.
lines.style: Polite manager closing the meeting, slight bow audible in tone, respectful and crisp
